digest.component_or_area: completion verifier banking and verdict assembly
problem_keywords: absence of evidence vs evidence of absence
propositions: At search exhaustion within bounded fallback, the verifier incorrectly banks met=false (evidence of absence) for criteria whose evidence exists but was not reached within the search budget window, producing false FAIL verdicts.

The fix introduces a tri-state evidence outcome (met, refuted, insufficient) via an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker that distinguishes search budget exhaustion from positive refutation, preserving false fail-closed behavior while correcting verdict semantics.

The marker is written only by the framework (never by model tools) through a new CriterionBank.record_insufficient() path when the bounded fallback fires; preserve-on-overwrite keeps the marker when a markerless met=false successor is harvested, only a bare met=false replaces it.

All verdict consumers (schema, validation, rendering, close gate, sidecar) must be updated together to emit evidence_sufficient:false distinguishing insufficient from unmet criteria in messages and remediation guidance.
